text:
AlexP: incident-bot just paged for embeddings latency spike in prod, page priority P1. seeing token-level timeouts. filling here so we don't duplicate: https://incidents.redwood/INC-1873 :rotating_light:
incident-bot: ALERT: embeddings.latency.p50 > 1200ms (5m) for service=embed-svc env=prod region=us-west - triggered 1861207654. symptoms: increased downstream request latency, some 504s to API gateway. pager: @eng-oncall. runbook: https://redwood.tools/runbooks/embeddings-latency
PriyaK: taking it. oncall handoff in 10. grabbing logs now. :coffee:
SamL: on standby. can you paste the quick query you used to surface the spike?
AlexP: pulled from datadog: `avg(last_5m):avg:embed.request.time{env:prod,model:embed-v2} by {cluster} > 1200` - cluster us-west-2a is the outlier. also saw kv-cache eviction rates jump.
MariaG: fyi customer-facing: small set of customers saw degraded embeddings (~5% of calls). CX already alerted. adding customer impact to incident ticket.
PriyaK: initial mitigation: temporarily increase worker replicas for embed-svc in us-west cluster, and switch fallback routing to cheaper quantized model embed-v1 for background jobs. doing that now. /deploy done.
ops-bot: deploy started: rollout embed-svc/us-west -> replicas 4 -> 12. CI: sha: b3d9c7e.
AlexP: after scaling, p50 dropped to ~700ms but p99 still ~2s. looks like a hot shard + cache miss pattern.
SamL: can we reduce alert noise while we triage? current threshold fires on short spikes. propose: add a 5m sustained condition and require p95 > 1500 for paging. Can we squash duplicate pages to eng-oncall for same incident?
MariaG: agreed. also want a dashboard tile to show kv-cache eviction rate next to latency so SREs can correlate quickly: https://analytics.redwood.com/d/embeddings-latency (proposed layout).
PriyaK: +1 to squelch rule. action items: 1) update metric threshold to p95 > 1500 sustained 5m, 2) add annotation in runbook that kv-cache evictions correlate with p99 spikes, 3) add dashboard panel, 4) add owner metadata and link to INC-1873. I'm going to patch alert and add note to runbook.
AlexP: LMK if you want me to open the PR for alert tweak. I can include example queries and rationale.
SamL: I got the dashboard change. I'll open PR for grafana panel: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/4821 - includes the eviction panel and a short note about expected baseline.
PriyaK: updating runbook now: adding section "eviction-mode mitigation" + example `kubectl scale` snippet and a note to check KV hit ratio. putting my name as owner until this is passed to Observability team. runbook draft: https://redwood.tools/runbooks/embeddings-latency#eviction-mode
AlexP: PR for alert tuning opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform-alerts/pull/912 - includes the 5m sustained condition and p95 threshold bump. please review.
incident-bot: note: paging policy changed? Not yet. Manual change scheduled by PriyaK.
MariaG: please add a short changelog entry to the runbook header with date and who changed thresholds. we need to track regressions.
PriyaK: done. runbook header now has `Last edited: 2026-03-15 by PriyaK` and `Change: alert threshold p95 > 1500 5m`. Also added `owner: Observability (saml@redwood)` and `incidents: INC-1873`
SamL: merged grafana PR. panel id 9032. linked in runbook.
AlexP: merged alert PR. will monitor for 30m and then remove manual squelch. if we keep seeing false positives we can make alert quieter. :thumbsup:
PriyaK: post-incident tasks assigned in INC-1873: add unit tests for alert rule, add automated annotation to incident when alert fires, and schedule a follow-up to evaluate cache configs. tagging @Observability.
MariaG: thanks team. CX notified customers impacted with tiny blurb and ETA resolution. closing pager now, we'll do a short blameless postmortem and a runbook update summary tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
AlexP: closing thread. thanks everyone.
